name: hw-path-text
title: Handwriting Along a Path
description: Handwriting flows along any SVG path, one letter at a time, over a faint dotted guide.
useWhen: A line should trail along a curve: a route, a journey, a signature swoosh.
You want to supply your own path and have the lettering follow it.
avoidWhen: The text must sit straight and centered: use hw-title or handwrite.
The path is much shorter than the text: letters past its end do not show.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Text
variables.description: The line written along the path.
variables.default: come on this wild journey with me...

variables.label: Path (wide frame)
variables.description: SVG path data in a 1920x1080 space, used on a landscape frame. The text follows it.

variables.label: Path (tall frame)
variables.description: SVG path data in a 1080x1920 space, used on a portrait frame.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Text size in the drawing space (1920 or 1080 wide).

variables.label: Guide line
variables.description: A faint dotted line draws along the path first.

variables.label: Letter delay
variables.description: Seconds between letters (it speeds up to fit long text).

variables.label: Boil
variables.description: Jitter the writing a little every third frame, like a hand-drawn loop.

variables.label: Boil amount
variables.description: How far the writing jitters, in pixels.
